answer: The ferrous holds work receipts rather than names, so the nebula of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, held in escrow until finality, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the wander of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
